column1: # Per-module compiler flags, appended to the defaults (scripts/oracle_config.py).

# settings, so the modules need not share flags. A row belongs here only with
# evidence: an A/B experiment (README "Flags") showing the flag makes more of
# that module's functions match. Longest prefix wins.
